Zoe Park: Pushed a fresh draft for the winter product launch post: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch-winter-v2
Ravi Menon: Quick pass  bench needs exact run metadata (date, model, hardware). Also confirm hero CTA goes to webinar signup not gated PDF.
Claire D: Agreed on webinar as primary. Hero CTA copy suggestion: 'See benchmarks & register' to keep expectations right.
Omar F: Bench note from run 2026-12-02: workload=kb-search, model=oak-14b quantized, batch=8, cost reduction 50% vs open baseline; p50 latency 95ms. Use this in methods.
Zoe Park: Nice. I'll add: 'Validated in our tests (kb-search, oak-14b, 2026-12-02)'. Legal preferred wording.
LegalBot: Redline: replace any "guarantee" or "best" claims with "validated in our tests" or "aims to". Add a methods disclaimer: 'Results may vary by workload and config.'
Ravi Menon: UTM pattern ops-friendly: campaign=winter-launch-26, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero-webinar|bench-methods. Example hero: ?utm_campaign=winter-launch-26&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero-webinar
Claire D: Inbound routing: webinar registrants should map to SDR_EU for EU/UK region_hint for first 72h, otherwise SDR_Global. After 72h forward to SDR_Backlog. Tag leads with nurture=launch-winter-webinar.
OpsHelper: Webhook schema validated. Required fields present: email, first_name, utm_campaign, utm_content, region_hint, nurture. Recommend adding lead_ttl_hours=72 for routing logic.
Omar F: Accessibility: hero chart alt text: 'Cost vs latency for oak-14b on kb-search workload (A100-40GB)'. Confirm color contrast.
Zoe Park: Timeline: final copy by 15:00 PT, legal signoff by 16:00 PT, staging webhook dry-run at 20:30 PT, staging publish at 21:30 PT. Please reply when you sign off.
Ravi Menon: I'll drop the UTM CSV in #ops by 13:30 PT and do a final read at 14:30 PT.
Claire D: I'll apply legal redlines and check alt text by 15:30 PT.
LegalBot: I'll confirm signoff if redlines applied; ETA 16:00 PT.
